links.comparator_used: Baseline CNN-BiLSTM outputting every prediction with no deferral (also compared with models optimized for calibration alone or uncertainty alone)
links.outcome: Seizure classification accuracy on retained samples
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 91.7% (baseline) to 99.6% while retaining ~74% of samples; outperformed models optimized for either calibration or uncertainty alone
links.tradeoff: About 26% of samples were flagged as unreliable and deferred for further clinical evaluation, which adds review workload.
links.quote: The selective classification improved accuracy from 91.7% (baseline) to 99.6% while retaining ∼74% of samples, outperforming models optimized for either calibration or uncertainty alone.

design_hint: uncertainty-based selective classification / referral for clinical review
